---
title: "HSC signature validation in Pellagatti et al. (GSE114922)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(pROC)
  library(GEOquery)
  library(Biobase)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
})

## =========================================================
## Paths
##   GSE114922_TPM_table.txt: supplementary file of GEO series GSE114922
##   (Pellagatti et al., 2018; CD34+ cells of MDS patients and healthy controls)
## =========================================================
PROJECT_DIR <- "/path/to/project"
TPM_FILE    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input/GSE114922/GSE114922_TPM_table.txt")
OUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "plots/figure6_validation")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

## HSC signature (figure6_srsf2_hsc_signature_analysis.Rmd)
UP   <- c("IL1RAP", "F13A1", "PLD1", "CNKSR2", "PRKCD", "HOMER3", "CFD", "COL4A5", "ANKRD18B")
DOWN <- c("AVP", "ALDH1A1", "CDH7", "TNFSF4", "SH3BP5", "ABI3BP")

group_colors <- c("Healthy_control" = "#3B7FB6", "SRSF2_mutant" = "#d24163")
```

```{r load data and GEO metadata}
# ============================================================
# 0) TPM table
# ============================================================
tpm <- read.delim(TPM_FILE, check.names = FALSE)
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(tpm), "ensembl_ID")

# ============================================================
# 1) Mutation and disease status from the GEO sample metadata.
#    The series matrix also contains the MON/GRA/ERY fractions
#    (131 samples in total), so restrict to the 90 CD34+ samples
#    present in the TPM table.
# ============================================================
gse <- GEOquery::getGEO("GSE114922", GSEMatrix = TRUE, getGPL = FALSE)
pdata <- if (is.list(gse)) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(gse, Biobase::pData))
} else {
  Biobase::pData(gse)
}

group_map <- pdata %>%
  dplyr::filter(title %in% sample_cols) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_col     = title,
    disease_status = `disease status:ch1`,
    srsf2_status   = `srsf2 mutational status:ch1`,
    sf3b1_status   = `sf3b1 mutational status:ch1`,
    u2af1_status   = `u2af1 mutational status:ch1`,
    zrsr2_status   = `zrsr2 mutational status:ch1`,
    patient_id     = `patient id:ch1`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("healthy|normal|control", disease_status, ignore.case = TRUE)   ~ "Healthy_control",
      grepl("mutant|mut|yes|positive|^1$", srsf2_status, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "SRSF2_mutant",
      TRUE                                                                   ~ "Other_MDS"
    )
  )

cat(sprintf("Matched %d / %d TPM sample columns to GEO metadata\n",
            nrow(group_map), length(sample_cols)))
print(table(group_map$group))

## SRSF2-mutant vs healthy controls only; label samples SRSF2_1..N / Healthy_1..N
group_map_use <- group_map %>%
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("SRSF2_mutant", "Healthy_control")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prefix = ifelse(group == "SRSF2_mutant", "SRSF2", "Healthy")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(prefix) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample = paste0(prefix, "_", dplyr::row_number())) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

cat(sprintf("Using %d SRSF2_mutant and %d Healthy_control samples\n",
            sum(group_map_use$group == "SRSF2_mutant"),
            sum(group_map_use$group == "Healthy_control")))
```

```{r signature score}
# ============================================================
# 2) Signature score = mean log2(TPM+1) of UP genes - mean of DOWN genes
#    The TPM table is indexed by Ensembl gene IDs -> map symbols first
# ============================================================
symbol_to_ensembl <- function(symbols) {
  mapped <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keys = symbols, keytype = "SYMBOL",
    column = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first"
  )
  mapped[!is.na(mapped)]
}

UP_ensembl   <- symbol_to_ensembl(UP)
DOWN_ensembl <- symbol_to_ensembl(DOWN)

tpm_mat <- as.matrix(tpm[, sample_cols])
rownames(tpm_mat) <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", tpm$ensembl_ID)   # strip Ensembl version suffixes
log2tpm <- log2(tpm_mat + 1)

up_present   <- intersect(UP_ensembl,   rownames(log2tpm))
down_present <- intersect(DOWN_ensembl, rownames(log2tpm))
cat(sprintf("UP genes found: %d / %d; DOWN genes found: %d / %d\n",
            length(up_present), length(UP), length(down_present), length(DOWN)))
stopifnot(length(up_present) > 0, length(down_present) > 0)

sig_score_all <- colMeans(log2tpm[up_present, , drop = FALSE]) -
                 colMeans(log2tpm[down_present, , drop = FALSE])

compare_df <- group_map_use %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sig_score = unname(sig_score_all[sample_col])) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_col, sample, group, sig_score)
```

```{r signature score plots}
theme_pub <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text         = element_text(colour = "black", size = 8.5),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 9.5),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.line         = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.title        = element_blank(),
    legend.key        = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.position   = "none"
  )

# ============================================================
# 3) Boxplot (Healthy vs SRSF2-mutant, CD34+)
# ============================================================
p_box <- ggplot(compare_df, aes(x = group, y = sig_score, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.2,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, seed = 1)) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = sample), size = 2.2, max.overlaps = Inf,
    segment.size = 0.2, segment.color = "grey40",
    box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.3,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, seed = 1),
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format",
    size = 2.6, label.y = max(compare_df$sig_score) + 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.15))) +
  labs(y = "SIG score (UP - DOWN, log2 TPM)", x = NULL) +
  theme_pub

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Pellagatti_CD34_SIG_score_boxplot.pdf"),
       p_box, width = 8, height = 6, units = "cm")
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Pellagatti_CD34_SIG_score_boxplot.png"),
       p_box, width = 8, height = 6, units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# ============================================================
# 4) Per-sample barplot, ordered by score
# ============================================================
compare_df_ord <- compare_df %>%
  dplyr::arrange(sig_score) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = sample))

p_bar <- ggplot(compare_df_ord, aes(x = sample, y = sig_score, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, linewidth = 0.2, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(y = "SIG score (UP - DOWN, log2 TPM)", x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 5, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm")
  )

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Pellagatti_CD34_SIG_score_barplot.pdf"),
       p_bar, width = 12, height = 6, units = "cm")
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Pellagatti_CD34_SIG_score_barplot.png"),
       p_bar, width = 12, height = 6, units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# ============================================================
# 5) ROC curve
# ============================================================
roc_obj <- pROC::roc(compare_df$group, compare_df$sig_score,
                     levels = c("Healthy_control", "SRSF2_mutant"),
                     quiet = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Pellagatti CD34+ AUROC = %.3f (%.3f-%.3f)\n",
            as.numeric(roc_obj$auc), roc_obj$ci[1], roc_obj$ci[3]))

roc_df <- data.frame(fpr = 1 - roc_obj$specificities, tpr = roc_obj$sensitivities)

p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(fpr, tpr)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_path(colour = group_colors["SRSF2_mutant"], linewidth = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.12, hjust = 0, size = 3,
           label = sprintf("AUROC = %.3f\n(%.3f-%.3f)",
                           as.numeric(roc_obj$auc), roc_obj$ci[1], roc_obj$ci[3])) +
  labs(x = "False positive rate", y = "True positive rate",
       title = "Pellagatti CD34+ MDS — ROC") +
  coord_equal() + theme_pub +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 10))

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Pellagatti_CD34_ROC.pdf"),
       p_roc, width = 7, height = 6, units = "cm")
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Pellagatti_CD34_ROC.png"),
       p_roc, width = 7, height = 6, units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r per-gene expression of the signature genes}
COLS <- c(Healthy_control = "#3b6ea5", SRSF2_mutant = "#d24163")

theme_gene <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "black"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

## --- gene table (symbol + direction, genes present only) ---
sig_tab <- data.frame(
  ensembl   = c(UP_ensembl, DOWN_ensembl),
  gene      = c(names(UP_ensembl), names(DOWN_ensembl)),
  direction = rep(c("UP", "DOWN"), c(length(UP_ensembl), length(DOWN_ensembl))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
sig_tab <- sig_tab[sig_tab$ensembl %in% rownames(log2tpm), ]
sig_tab$direction <- factor(sig_tab$direction, levels = c("UP", "DOWN"))

## --- samples ordered by signature score within group ---
sample_tab <- compare_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Healthy_control", "SRSF2_mutant"))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group, sig_score)

## --- long expression table ---
m <- log2tpm[sig_tab$ensembl, sample_tab$sample_col, drop = FALSE]
rownames(m) <- sig_tab$gene
expr_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(m), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(expr_long) <- c("gene", "sample_col", "log2tpm")

expr_long <- expr_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sig_tab[, c("gene", "direction")], by = "gene") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_tab[, c("sample_col", "sample", "group")], by = "sample_col") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene   = factor(gene,   levels = sig_tab$gene),
    sample = factor(sample, levels = sample_tab$sample)
  )

## --- per-gene statistics (Wilcoxon + AUROC) ---
gene_stats <- expr_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, direction) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_SRSF2   = mean(log2tpm[group == "SRSF2_mutant"]),
    mean_Healthy = mean(log2tpm[group == "Healthy_control"]),
    delta        = mean_SRSF2 - mean_Healthy,
    p_wilcox     = suppressWarnings(
                     wilcox.test(log2tpm[group == "SRSF2_mutant"],
                                 log2tpm[group == "Healthy_control"])$p.value),
    auroc        = as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(
                     response  = as.integer(group == "SRSF2_mutant"),
                     predictor = log2tpm, quiet = TRUE, direction = "<"))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(padj = p.adjust(p_wilcox, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(direction, p_wilcox)

print(as.data.frame(gene_stats %>% dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3)))))
write.csv(gene_stats, file.path(OUT_DIR, "pergene_stats_pellagatti.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# 6) Heatmap: genes x samples, z-scored per gene
# ============================================================
hm <- expr_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(z = as.numeric(scale(log2tpm))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

p_hm <- ggplot(hm, aes(sample, gene, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(direction ~ group, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-2, 2), oob = scales::squish,
                       name = "z-score\n(log2 TPM)") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(hm$gene))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "HSC signature genes — per-sample expression (GSE114922)") +
  theme_gene +
  theme(axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
        axis.line     = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.15, "lines"))

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "pergene_heatmap_pellagatti.png"), p_hm,
       width = 7.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# ============================================================
# 7) Per-gene boxplots, one facet per gene
# ============================================================
lab_stats <- gene_stats %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lab = sprintf("p = %.3g", p_wilcox)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(expr_long %>% dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
                     dplyr::summarise(ytop = max(log2tpm), .groups = "drop"), by = "gene")

p_box_gene <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(group, log2tpm, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, size = 1.1, shape = 21,
              fill = "white", colour = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = lab_stats, aes(x = 1.5, y = ytop, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene + direction, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5,
             labeller = labeller(.multi_line = FALSE)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COLS, name = NULL,
                    labels = c("Healthy control", "SRSF2-mutant")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Healthy", "SRSF2")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(log[2]*"(TPM + 1)"),
       title = "HSC signature genes — expression by group (GSE114922)") +
  theme_gene + theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "pergene_boxplots_pellagatti.png"), p_box_gene,
       width = 11, height = 2.3 * ceiling(nrow(sig_tab) / 5) + 1, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
